evidence: Spectroscopic ellipsometry was used to measure the film thickness and the dielectric function of the films. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to analyze the film compositions. Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) and proton-induced gamma ray emission (PIGE) were used to calibrate the sensitivity factors used in XPS quantification. X-ray diffraction (XRD) was used to study the structural properties. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was performed to understand the nanostructure of the films. Four-point probe measurements and Hall measurements were used to determine the resistivity and carrier concentration. UV-VIS-NIR spectroscopy was used to study the optical transparency. Ellipsometry was used to measure the optical properties.
